subject: Product page microcopy + metering footnote alignment for AWS offer
messages:
From: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@aws.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing - final product page copy + metering details needed

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the draft we received last week. Before we can promote the offer to the catalog queue, we need two short items from Redwood and Acme: 1) final product page microcopy for the hero and three bullets (50–120 characters each) and 2) a concise metering/pricing footnote that maps usage to billable units (one or two sentences + a one-line example).

A couple of constraints from the marketplace team:
- Hero should be <= 120 characters.
- Bullet lines should avoid absolute claims like "instant" or "zero error rate"; stick to measurable benefits.
- Footnote must include the billing unit (e.g., "per API call, per 1k tokens") and a short example showing monthly cost estimate for a typical workload.

Can you share the final copy and the required attachments (manifest, screenshots) by EOD Monday Aug 24? Also please attach any evidence for the "low-latency" claim (latency p50/p95 numbers or a perf note).

Thanks,
Sam Thomas
AWS Marketplace Ops
[Attachment: marketplace-request-checklist.pdf]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@aws.com>, Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing - final product page copy + metering details needed

Hi Sam / Elena,

Appreciate the checklist — attaching a consolidated package for review. Key items attached: product-page-draft-v3.docx, metering-footnote-draft.md, usage-examples.csv, and a short perf note with p50/p95 from our Dedicated pool.

Below is the proposed microcopy (hero + 3 bullets) and the metering footnote we suggest. I kept the hero under 120 chars and the bullets benefit-focused and measurable.

Hero (95 chars): Redwood Inference — predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference for production workloads

Bullets (each ~90 chars):
- Predictable latency: p95 <= 220ms for standard gen workloads on dedicated pools
- Lower unit cost with automatic batching and KV caching for repeat prefixes
- Deployment flexibility: hosted, dedicated, and private VPC options

Metering footnote (single-paragraph):
Metering: billed per 1k token-generation units. Example: a 100k-token monthly workload (typical small-scale analytics) is billed as 100 token-units; at $X.XX per 1k token-generation units this maps to ~ $Y/month (estimate excludes data transfer). See usage-examples.csv for scenario breakout.

Open questions for the marketplace listing team:
1) Is the pricing placeholder $X.XX acceptable in the copy, or do we need to lock a hard public price now?
2) For the "p95 <= 220ms" callout, do you want us to attach the detailed perf-run scripts or a summarized perf note? We included both the perf note and raw CSV.

Next steps we propose:
- Marketplace: quick pass on microcopy + metering language by Thu Aug 20
- We will iterate and send final doc by EOD Mon Aug 24 for catalog queueing

Thanks — attaching files here.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partner Manager, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: product-page-draft-v3.docx] [Attachment: metering-footnote-draft.md]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing - final product page copy + metering details needed

Priya — quick internal pass before we send final. A few small edits and one ask.

Edits suggested:
- Hero: shorten to remove the word "production" to keep it snappier; proposed: "Predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference for product teams" (78 chars).
- Bullet 1: change p95 figure to "p95 <= 200ms" if we can support it in the perf note (looks better on the page).
- Bullet 2: rephrase "Lower unit cost" to "Reduce per-token cost" to be explicit.

Ask: add a one-line observability callout in the bullets referencing the Console (e.g., "Per-route latency & token cost breakdowns in Redwood Console") — customers ask for that often and it helps conversion.

If you want I can apply edits directly to product-page-draft-v3 and return a v4.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@aws.com>, Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: product page copy + metering footnote (updated per internal pass)

Hi Sam / Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We consolidated internal feedback and attached the final assets (product-page-draft-v4.docx, metering-footnote-final.md). Summary of changes below (short and ready for catalog):

Final Hero (78 chars): Predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference for product teams

Final Bullets:
- Predictable latency: p95 <= 200ms on Dedicated pools (see perf note)
- Reduce per-token cost with automatic batching and KV caching
- Per-route latency & token cost breakdowns in Redwood Console

Final Metering footnote (final):
Metering: billed per 1k token-generation units. Example: a 100k-token monthly workload is billed as 100 token-units; at $0.35 per 1k token-generation units this maps to ~$35/month (example excludes data transfer, rounding applied). See attached usage-examples.csv for scenario breakout.

Attachments included: product-page-draft-v4.docx, metering-footnote-final.md, perf-summary-0805.pdf (p50/p95 from dedicated pools), usage-examples.csv.

Open items for AWS team:
- Public price: we included $0.35 as our placeholder. If you require a different public price now, let us know and we will update the doc prior to catalog queueing.
- Evidence: perf-summary-0805.pdf contains anonymized runs; happy to provide raw logs under NDA if that helps.

Proposed schedule: go/no-go by EOD Aug 24; if green we ask AWS to queue the offer for catalog promotion on Aug 27.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partner Manager, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: product-page-draft-v4.docx] [Attachment: metering-footnote-final.md] [Attachment: perf-summary-0805.pdf]

From: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-ops@aws.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FINAL: product page copy + metering footnote (updated per internal pass)

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with our constraints. Two quick notes: 1) $0.35 per 1k token-generation units is acceptable for the public listing placeholder; 2) perf-summary-0805.pdf is sufficient for catalog review (no raw logs needed at this stage).

We will queue the offer for catalog promotion on Aug 27. Please sign the attached co-sell addendum; DocuSign link below. Once countersigned we will enable the co-sell badge and route to field teams.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/secure/sign?example=ACME-1198

Elena — can you confirm Acme is ok with the public price?

Sam Thomas
AWS Marketplace Ops
